The '''Lorellian language''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by residents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorell]], which was located just outside the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].

==History==
In [[44 ABY]], the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] assisted the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], which came under attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. During the evacuation, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] strayed into the free-fire zone, prompting [[Aegel Squadron]], a Hapan [[Miy'til starfighter]] squadron, into firing. Hapan agent [[Taryn Zel]], who was aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', sent a message in ancient Lorellian to the [[Unidentified officer of Aegel Squadron|officer]] of the Aegels and quickly cleared the misunderstanding.<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
